heading: Contract
intro: Selected contract and independent work delivered alongside full-time roles.

items.summary: A multi-LLM engine that reads market data, reaches a consensus view, and trades on it, built to give traders an instant, defensible read instead of a dashboard to interpret.
outcomes: Designed a multi-LLM orchestration engine that analyses OHLCV market data and produces consensus-based market insights.
Built a real-time automated trading system executing trades on Binance and Bybit from combined LLM and ML signals.
Implemented rate-limited asset analysis APIs (2 tokens per 4 hours) to keep inference cost and usage under control.
Delivered a fully dockerized, fault-tolerant trading and analytics pipeline.

items.summary: An end-to-end hiring pipeline that sources candidates, reads their résumés, screens them, and books the interview, without a recruiter touching a spreadsheet.
outcomes: Automated candidate sourcing, résumé analysis, screening and interview scheduling.
Implemented GDPR-compliant data flow and Google Calendar integration.

items.summary: ERP for a bespoke tailoring business: inventory, customer measurements and payments in one system, with access control tight enough for multi-branch use.
outcomes: Built ERP modules for inventory, customer measurements and payments.
Implemented RBAC, secure API authentication and background task processing.

items.summary: Detecting recurring transactions in messy financial data, where the same merchant never spells its name the same way twice.
outcomes: Developed clustering and fuzzy-matching pipelines for recurring transaction detection.
Deployed containerised ML services on AWS ECS (Fargate).
